corpus_stability.reason: The Oklahoma Driver Manual is a periodically revised official edition, so Section Ten sharing rules change at most with new editions.

market_signal.origin_note: market signal is authored in part E

sections.heading: C2 — Confusables and KG hints
sections.markdown:
## C2 — Confusables and KG hints, Sharing the Road

FACT_ID: sec10-R01 | anchor: A01
Walkers, skaters, and wheeled-aid users own crosswalks marked or not, and drivers play it safe for strays [A01].
Why it matters: group pedestrians; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F01 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec10-R02 | anchor: A01
Blind users, children, and driveway crossers earn yields without rushing, and hidden crossers earn brake-tap shields [A01].
Why it matters: group ped-rules; difficulty medium; prereq sec10-F01; confusables sec10-F02 [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0050]

FACT_ID: sec10-R03 | anchor: A02
Bikes share equal rights and swerve for hazards, and passes must clear three feet by statute [A02].
Why it matters: group bike-rights; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F03 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec10-R04 | anchor: A02
Never squeeze bikes against oncoming traffic, refuse narrow passes, brief-honk the unwary, and merge before right turns [A02].
Why it matters: group bike-passing; difficulty medium; prereq sec10-F03; confusables sec10-F04 [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0051]

FACT_ID: sec10-R05 | anchor: A03
Full lanes open for overtaking, left-turn staging, hazard dodges, and unshareable narrows [A03].
Why it matters: group bike-lane; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec10-F05 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec10-R06 | anchor: A03
Bikes slow at stops and halt only for danger, while reds demand stops with hazard-yielded passage [A03].
Why it matters: group bike-signals; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec10-F06 [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0052]

FACT_ID: sec10-R07 | anchor: A04
Most bike crashes come from blind turning drivers, so riders own full lanes behind M endorsements [A04].
Why it matters: group moto-visibility; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec10-F07 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec10-R08 | anchor: A04
Pass wide and gentle, signal turns, trail three seconds, and read position shifts as messages [A04].
Why it matters: group moto-technique; difficulty medium; prereq sec10-F07; confusables sec10-F08 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec10-R09 | anchor: A04
Intersections wait out clear intent, nights dim for single lamps, and eyes or shields guard faces [A04].
Why it matters: group moto-care; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F09 [A04].
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0053]

FACT_ID: sec10-R10 | anchor: A05
Followers stay visible outside cab-flank and two-hundred-foot rear blinds with rollback gaps uphill [A05].
Why it matters: group truck-follow; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec10-F10 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec10-R11 | anchor: A05
Announce passes with blinks, finish fast without lingering or downhill slowdowns, and meet far right [A05].
Why it matters: group truck-pass; difficulty medium; prereq sec10-F10; confusables sec10-F11 [A05].
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0054]

FACT_ID: sec10-R12 | anchor: A06
Wide right turns forbid curb-gap entry, and backing rigs forbid crossing behind [A06].
Why it matters: group truck-risk; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec10-F12 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec10-R13 | anchor: A06
Trains own absolute priority through mile-long stops, beating impatience and negligence alike [A06].
Why it matters: group train-row; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F13 [A06].
Source: [A06 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0055]

FACT_ID: sec10-R14 | anchor: A07
Rail approaches halt fifty out and fifteen back across signals, gates, near-audible trains, and plainly close consists [A07].
Why it matters: group rail-law; difficulty high; prereq sec10-F13; confusables sec10-F14 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec10-R15 | anchor: A07
Advance signs, R-X-R paint, yield-crossbucks, flashers, gates, and stop signs each stage the halt [A07].
Why it matters: group rail-devices; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec10-F15 [A07].
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0056]

FACT_ID: sec10-R16 | anchor: A08
Never trap on rails, never circle gates, evacuate stalls in twenty seconds toward-train angled, and call for help with ENS detail [A08].
Why it matters: group rail-escape; difficulty high; prereq none; confusables sec10-F16 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec10-R17 | anchor: A08
Buses and hazmat haulers halt at rails, passing bars everyone, and size lies about train speed [A08].
Why it matters: group rail-caution; difficulty medium; prereq none; confusables sec10-F17 [A08].
Source: [A08 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0057]

FACT_ID: sec10-R18 | anchor: A09
Farm giants crawl under twenty-five, animal rigs share fragile equality, and SMV emblems flag the slowest [A09].
Why it matters: group slow-vehicles; difficulty low; prereq none; confusables sec10-F18 [A09].
Source: [A09 -> src:rdmv-ok-d:service-oklahoma-sok:handbook:pdf-0058]
